sources.citation: Pelkey, Jamin R. 2011. A Phula Comparative Lexicon: Phola, Phuza, Muji, Phowa, Azha. SIL Language and Culture Documentation and Description 18. Dallas: SIL International. 144 pp.
sources.note: Phupha enters only as wordlist datapoint 'FKC Phupha: Gejiu County (Shi), Jiasha, Fengkou 个旧市贾沙乡风口' and in sec. 4.5 'The Downriver meso-clade of Riverine Phula' (tone-class innovations: TC-1 > /21/ with /33/ splits, checked-tone merger > /55/, TC-2 split to /13/; Phupha ȵ̥i¹³ma²¹ 'stomach' < 'heart'). The five 'phonology in brief' sketches in sec. 3 are Phola, Phuza, Muji, Hlepho Phowa and Azha -- no Phupha sketch. 'stress'/'accent' occur 0 times in the book.
Tertiary; cluster article (Phupha/Alugu/Phupa/Phuza) citing only Pelkey 2011; no phonology.
